HeavyShot.name: Heavy Shot
HeavyShot.notes: Level-sync fallback only; trait-upgraded to Burst Shot at 76. Never expected at level 100. Not Barrage-eligible: only Refulgent Arrow carries the triple-hit tooltip.

BurstShot.name: Burst Shot
BurstShot.notes: Filler GCD; 35 percent Hawk's Eye. Not Barrage-eligible: the triple hit appears only on Refulgent Arrow's tooltip.

RefulgentArrow.name: Refulgent Arrow
RefulgentArrow.notes: Consumes Hawk's Eye. The only Barrage triple-hit weaponskill: under Barrage it lands three times (280 x 3 = 840).

Stormbite.name: Stormbite
Stormbite.notes: Applies the Stormbite DoT (25 potency per 3 s tick, 45 s).

CausticBite.name: Caustic Bite
CausticBite.notes: Applies the Caustic Bite DoT (20 potency per 3 s tick, 45 s).

IronJaws.name: Iron Jaws
IronJaws.notes: Refreshes and re-snapshots the DoTs already on the target; it never applies a missing one, so on a clean target it is a bare 100-potency GCD. The refresh is performed by Simulation._iron_jaws, not by grants.

ApexArrow.name: Apex Arrow
ApexArrow.notes: Potency scales with Soul Voice (140 at 20 gauge to 700 at 100); see job.apex and tables.apex_potency. Straight-line AoE at full potency to every enemy hit, so no falloff. The BlastArrowReady grant applies only when the gauge spent was at least job.apex.blast_gauge_threshold; the core gates it.

BlastArrow.name: Blast Arrow
BlastArrow.notes: Follow-up to a high-gauge Apex Arrow. 700 to the first enemy, 50 percent less to every other one, so a secondary target takes a 0.5 damage share.

ResonantArrow.name: Resonant Arrow
ResonantArrow.notes: Barrage follow-up. 640 to the first enemy, 50 percent less to every other one, so a secondary target takes a 0.5 damage share.

RadiantEncore.name: Radiant Encore
RadiantEncore.notes: Potency 700/800/1100 by the coda count consumed by the Finale that granted it; see job.radiant_encore_potency. AoE around the target: 50 percent less to every enemy after the first.

Ladonsbite.name: Ladonsbite
Ladonsbite.notes: AoE cone, 140 potency per target, no falloff. Not Barrage-eligible and it does not consume the buff.

Shadowbite.name: Shadowbite
Shadowbite.notes: AoE, 200 potency per target, no falloff; consumes Hawk's Eye. Under Barrage the tooltip raises the potency to 300 per target; it does NOT hit three times. Casting it under Barrage still consumes the buff. Its level-sync precursor Wide Volley is 140 / 220 and is absent from CielBardData.Actions, so it has no record here.

QuickNock.name: Quick Nock
QuickNock.notes: Pre-76 fallback; trait-upgraded to Ladonsbite. Never expected at level 100. Not Barrage-eligible, like Ladonsbite.

EmpyrealArrow.name: Empyreal Arrow
EmpyrealArrow.notes: Grants one guaranteed Repertoire proc on use.

HeartbreakShot.name: Heartbreak Shot
HeartbreakShot.notes: 3 charges of 15 s; the live client reports cdmax 45 with recasttime 15. A Mage's Ballad Repertoire proc refunds job.ballad_charge_reduction_s of recast.

Bloodletter.name: Bloodletter
Bloodletter.notes: Trait-upgraded to Heartbreak Shot at 92, so unavailable at level 100. Shares the charge pool. The brief's 130 potency is the pre-upgrade value.

RainOfDeath.name: Rain of Death
RainOfDeath.notes: Shares the Heartbreak Shot charge pool.

PitchPerfect.name: Pitch Perfect
PitchPerfect.notes: Wanderer's Minuet only. Potency 100/220/360 by Repertoire stacks; see job.pitch_perfect_potency.

Barrage.name: Barrage
Barrage.notes: Grants a guaranteed Hawk's Eye, the 10 s Barrage buff and the 30 s Resonant Arrow window. The buff makes the next Refulgent Arrow hit three times (statuses.json weaponskill_hits) or, on Shadowbite / Wide Volley, raises the potency instead (actions.json barrage_potency).

RadiantFinale.name: Radiant Finale
RadiantFinale.notes: Consumes every coda; the buff multiplier is job.coda_damage_mult[n].

MagesBallad.name: Mage's Ballad
MagesBallad.notes: Repertoire reduces the shared charge recast.

Windbite.name: Windbite
Windbite.notes: Pre-64 fallback; trait-upgraded to Stormbite. Never used at level 100.

VenomousBite.name: Venomous Bite
VenomousBite.notes: Pre-64 fallback; trait-upgraded to Caustic Bite. Never used at level 100.

Potion.name: Gemdraught of Dexterity
Potion.notes: Placeholder id: potions are addressed by hqid through GetItem, not by action id, so they are absent from CielBardData.Actions and verify_against_lua skips kind=item records.
